description: This file defines the CriteriaVisitor interface for implementing visitors that process search criteria in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for logical operations like AND, OR, NOR, and specific criteria like existence and filtering.

classes.name: CriteriaVisitor
classes.description: Interface for visitors that process search criteria with methods for logical and filtering operations.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Applies 'and' semantics to a list of criteria.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Applies 'any' semantics, representing a wildcard or match-all criteria.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Checks existence of a field via ExistsFieldExpression.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Applies filtering semantics with a field expression and predicate.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Applies 'nor' semantics to a list of criteria.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Applies 'or' semantics to a list of criteria.
